page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, making it reliant entirely on CPU-based execution.

Given the high density of dedicated vCPUs relative to memory, this instance class offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The resource allocation profile is suited for high-performance computing, batch processing, web serving at scale, and CPU-intensive application servers.
